paragraphs: Steven Madden, Ltd. and its subsidiaries design, source, and market fashion-forward branded and private label footwear, accessories, and apparel. We distribute our products through the wholesale channel to department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, shoe chains, online retailers, national chains, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and Mexico. Additionally, the Company operates in other international markets through its joint ventures in South Africa, the Middle East, Israel, Australia, various countries in Europe, Latin America, and certain countries in Asia, and through special distribution arrangements in various European countries, North Africa, South and Central America, and various countries within the Asia-Pacific region. We also distribute our products through our direct-to-consumer channel, which includes company-operated retail stores, third-party concessions in international markets, and e-commerce platforms, in the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Mexico, South Africa, the Middle East, Israel, and various countries in Europe, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific region.

Our product offerings include a diverse range of contemporary styles, designed to establish or capitalize on market trends, complemented by core product offerings. We are recognized for our design creativity and ability to deliver trend-right products with high quality at accessible price points, efficiently and with speed-to-market.
The following is a description of our business as of December 31, 2025. OUR SEGMENTS

Our Wholesale Footwear segment designs, sources, and markets our brands and sells our products, consisting of footwear, to department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, shoe chains, online retailers, national chains, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and Mexico. Additionally, the Company operates in other international markets through its joint ventures in South Africa, the Middle East, Israel, Australia, various countries in Europe, Latin America, and certain countries in Asia, and through special distribution arrangements in various European countries, North Africa, South and Central America, and various countries within the Asia-Pacific region. Our Wholesale Footwear products are designed and marketed for various lifestyles and include dress shoes, boots, booties, fashion sneakers, sandals, and casual shoes. The Wholesale Footwear segment consists of the following brands: Steve Madden®, Kurt Geiger®, Dolce Vita®, Betsey Johnson®, Blondo®, Carvela®, and Anne Klein®. This segment also includes our private label footwear business. This segment represented 40.9% of total revenue during 2025.

Our Wholesale Accessories/Apparel segment designs, sources, and markets our brands and sells our products, primarily consisting of handbags and apparel, to department stores, mass merchants, off-price retailers, online retailers, specialty retailers, independent stores, and clubs throughout the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, and Mexico. Additionally, the Company operates in other international markets through its joint ventures in South Africa, the Middle East, Israel, Australia, various countries in Europe, Latin America, and certain countries in Asia, and through special distribution arrangements in various European countries, North Africa, South and Central America, and various countries within the Asia-Pacific region. Our Wholesale Accessories/Apparel business consists of handbags, apparel, small leather goods, belts, soft accessories, fashion scarves, wraps, gifting, and other trend accessories. The Wholesale Accessories/Apparel segment consists of the following brands: Steve Madden®, Kurt Geiger®, Dolce Vita®, Betsey Johnson®, Carvela®, ATM®, and Anne Klein®. This segment also includes our private label handbag and accessories business. This segment represented 25.3% of total revenue during 2025.

Our Direct-to-Consumer segment engages in the sale of footwear, handbags, apparel, and other trend accessories through Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger, Carvela, Dolce Vita, and ATM full-price retail stores, Steve Madden, Kurt Geiger and Carvela outlet stores, directly-operated concessions in international markets, and directly-operated e-commerce platforms. We operate retail locations in regional malls and shopping centers, as well as high streets in various cities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Mexico, South Africa, the Middle East, Israel, Europe, Latin America, and the Asia-Pacific region. Through our concessions business, we also operate footwear concessions within several luxury and premium department stores in the UK and various department stores in international markets. Our stores play an important role in our test-and-react strategy, and also serve as fulfillment and return locations for our e-commerce business. Our stores also serve as a marketing tool that allows us to strengthen global brand recognition and to showcase selected items from our full line of

branded and licensed products. In addition to these testing and marketing benefits, we have also been able to leverage sales information gathered at Steve Madden retail stores and our e-commerce platforms to assist our wholesale customers in their order placement and inventory management. We believe that our retail stores and e-commerce platforms enhance overall sales and profitability and our ability to react quickly to changing consumer demands.

As of December 31, 2025, we operated 399 brick-and-mortar retail stores, including 251 Steve Madden full-price stores and 69 outlet stores, 31 Kurt Geiger London full-price stores and 17 outlet stores, 14 Carvela full-price stores and 12 outlet stores, four Dolce Vita full-price stores, and one ATM full-price store. In addition, we ended the year with 21 concessions in Taiwan, 20 concessions in South Africa, 16 concessions in Australia, two concessions in each of Portugal and China, and 72 footwear concessions within several luxury and premium department stores in the United Kingdom, totaling 133 concessions in international markets.

In addition to our brick-and-mortar stores, our Direct-to-Consumer business offers products online through our e-commerce platforms in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, Mexico, and through our joint ventures in international markets. We operate seven branded e-commerce websites, which include: www.stevemadden.com, www.kurtgeiger.com, www.dolcevita.com, www.betseyjohnson.com, www.blondo.com, www.carvela.com, and www.atmcollection.com. This segment represented 33.4% of total revenue during 2025.

Our Licensing segment engages in the licensing of the Steve Madden®, Kurt Geiger®, and Betsey Johnson® trademarks for use in the sale of select apparel, accessories, and home categories as well as various other non-core products. Most of our license agreements require the licensee to pay the Company a royalty based on actual revenue, a minimum royalty in the event predetermined revenue targets are not achieved and a percentage of sales for brand advertising. This segment represented 0.5% of total revenue during 2025.

Corporate does not constitute a reportable segment and includes costs not directly attributable to the reportable operating segments. These expenses are primarily related to corporate executives, corporate finance, corporate social responsibility, legal, human resources, information technology, cybersecurity, and other shared services.
For additional information on our segments, refer to Note 18 – Operating Segment Information in the Notes to our consolidated financial statements included in this Annual Report.

Steve Madden. We design, source, and market fashion-forward footwear, accessories, and apparel under the Steve Madden brand. The Steve Madden brand is a leader in the fashion footwear industry with permission from the customer to sell products across most footwear categories including dress shoes, boots, booties, fashion sneakers, and casuals. While the brand appeals to a wide demographic, the core target consumer is 18 to 40 years old. The Steve Madden brand is sold globally, including in the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada, Mexico, Africa, the Asia-Pacific region, the Middle East, and South and Central America.

Kurt Geiger London. Kurt Geiger® is a London-based accessible luxury accessories and footwear brand, well known for its unique brand image, bold and distinctive design aesthetic and compelling value proposition. Founded in 1963, Kurt Geiger is headquartered in London, United Kingdom. In May 2025, we acquired the Kurt Geiger® trademark via our acquisition of Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited ("MATL"), the ultimate parent company of Kurt Geiger. The Kurt Geiger® brand is sold globally, including in the United Kingdom, United States, Europe, Mexico, and the Asia-Pacific region.

headings: The loss of Steve Madden, our Founder and Creative and Design Chief, or members of our executive management team could have a material adverse effect on our business.
If we are not successful in implementing our growth strategy or integrating acquired businesses, we may not be able to take advantage of certain market opportunities and may become less competitive.
If one or more of our significant customers were to reduce or stop purchases of our products, our sales and profits could decline.
Our financial results are subject to quarterly fluctuations.
Extreme or unseasonable weather conditions in locations where we or our customers and suppliers are located could adversely affect our business.

We sell products to most of our wholesale customers on credit, subject to customary trade payment terms, and their failure to pay for products shipped to them could adversely affect our financial results.
Our stock price may fluctuate substantially if our operating results are inconsistent with our forecasts or those of analysts who follow us.
Failure to successfully integrate the business and operations of Kurt Geiger could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and future growth prospects.
We have recorded goodwill and identifiable intangible assets in connection with our acquisition of Kurt Geiger, which could become impaired and adversely affect our financial results.
Our global operations expose us to a variety of legal, regulatory, political, and economic risks that may adversely impact our results of operations in certain regions.
Our business is exposed to foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
Disruption of our information technology systems or e-commerce platforms could have a material and adverse impact on our financial results and brand equity.
Our business could be adversely affected by data security breaches or privacy failures involving our systems or those of our third-party partners.
Risks related to the deployment of artificial intelligence and machine learning could adversely impact our operations and financial condition.
A portion of our revenue is dependent on licensing our trademarks. The actions of our licensees could diminish our brand integrity and adversely affect our revenue and results of operations.
Changes in economic conditions may adversely affect our financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity.
Litigation or other legal proceedings could divert management resources and result in costs that adversely affect our operating results from quarter to quarter.
We may be subject to additional tax liabilities as a result of audits by various taxing authorities.
Changes in tax laws could have an adverse effect on our financial results.
Any failure to maintain effective internal control over our financial reporting could materially and adversely affect us.
paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties we describe below as well as all other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K before making any investment decisions. The risks and uncertainties included here are not exhaustive. Other sections within this report discuss additional factors that could adversely affect our business. Our industry is highly competitive and constantly evolving, and we may face additional risks that are presently unknown, deemed immaterial, or unforeseen. If any of these risks and uncertainties were to materialize, our business, financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity could be materially and adversely affected.

The fashion footwear, accessories, and apparel industry is subject to rapid changes in consumer preferences. If we do not accurately anticipate fashion trends and promptly respond to consumer demand, we could lose sales, our relationships with customers could be harmed, and our brand loyalty could be diminished.

The strength of our brands and our success depends in large part, upon our ability to anticipate and promptly respond to product and fashion trends, as well as to anticipate, gauge, and react to changing consumer demands in a timely manner. There can be no assurance that our products will correspond to the changes in taste and demand or that we will be able to successfully advertise and market products that respond to trends and customer preferences. If we misjudge the market for our products, we may be faced with significant excess inventories for some products and missed opportunities as to others. In addition, misjudgments in merchandise selection could adversely affect our brand image with our customers, resulting in lower sales and increased markdown allowances for customers, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity.

We face intense competition from both established companies and newer entrants into the market. Our failure to compete effectively could cause our market share to decline, which could harm our reputation and have a material adverse impact on our financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity.

The fashion footwear, accessories, and apparel industry is highly competitive and barriers to entry are low. Our competitors include specialty companies as well as companies with diversified product lines. Market growth in the sales of fashion footwear, accessories, and apparel has encouraged the entry of many new competitors and increased competition from established companies. Many of these competitors may have significantly greater financial and other resources than we do, and there can be no assurance that we will be able to compete successfully with other fashion footwear, accessories, and apparel companies. Increased competition could result in pricing pressures, increased marketing expenditures, and loss of market share and could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity.

If we and the retailers that are our customers are unable to adapt to recent and anticipated changes in the retail industry, the sales of our products may decline, which could have a material adverse effect on our financial condition, results of operations, and liquidity.

Australia Joint Venture. In January 2025, the Company acquired a 50.1% controlling financial interest in the newly formed entity, SM Fashion Australia Pty Ltd. This joint venture was formed to expand the distribution of our products across Australia and New Zealand through wholesale and direct-to-consumer channels. The results of this joint venture are included within the Wholesale Footwear, Wholesale Accessories/Apparel, and Direct-to-Consumer segments.

Malaysia Joint Venture. In January 2025, the Company acquired an additional 2.0% equity interest in SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd was originally formed in July 2022, at which time we held a 49.0% non-controlling interest in the entity. The Company now holds a 51.0% controlling financial interest in the entity. SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd engages in the distribution of our products across Malaysia through the direct-to-consumer channel. The results of this joint venture are included within the Direct-to-Consumer segment.

Acquisition of Kurt Geiger. In May 2025, the Company completed its previously announced acquisition of the entire issued share capital of Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited ("MATL") for a preliminary purchase price of $403,348.

MATL is the ultimate parent company of the Kurt Geiger business ("Kurt Geiger"), which operates primarily in the United Kingdom (the "UK"), U.S., and Europe. Kurt Geiger designs and sells footwear and accessories under its own brands – including Kurt Geiger London, KG Kurt Geiger, and Carvela – through its direct-to-consumer channel, which consists of directly-operated retail stores and e-commerce, as well as through the wholesale channel, and operates third-party concessions in luxury and premium department stores primarily in the UK. Kurt Geiger was founded in 1963 and is headquartered in London, UK.

Steven Madden, Ltd. 以及其子公司設計、來源並行銷時尚前衛的品牌與自有品牌鞋類、配件及服飾。我們透過通路通路將產品銷售至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、鞋類連鎖店、線上零售商、全國連鎖店、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部。此外，本公司透過在南非、中東、以色列、澳洲、歐洲各國、拉丁美洲及亞洲部分國家的合資企業，以及在歐洲各國、北非、南美及中美洲以及亞太地區各國的特殊分銷安排，經營其他國際市場。我們也透過直接對消費者通路銷售產品，包括本公司經營的零售商店、國際市場的第三方租賃店面及電商平台，於美國、英國、加拿大、墨西哥、南非、中東、以色列及歐洲、拉丁美洲及亞太地區各國銷售。
我們的產品組合包含多樣化的當代風格，旨在建立或把握市場趨勢，並搭配核心產品。我們以設計創意及能以親民價格提供高品質、符合時尚趨勢的產品，並具備快速上市的效率而聞名。
以下為截至2025年12月31日的業務說明。我們的應報告分部

我們的通路鞋類應報告分部設計、來源並行銷我們的品牌，並銷售鞋類產品至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、鞋類連鎖店、線上零售商、全國連鎖店、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部。此外，本公司透過在南非、中東、以色列、澳洲、歐洲各國、拉丁美洲及亞洲部分國家的合資企業，以及在歐洲各國、北非、南美及中美洲以及亞太地區各國的特殊分銷安排，經營其他國際市場。我們的通路鞋類產品為不同生活方式設計並行銷，包括正裝鞋、靴子、短靴、時尚運動鞋、涼鞋及休閒鞋。通路鞋類應報告分部包含以下品牌：Steve Madden®、Kurt Geiger®、Dolce Vita®、Betsey Johnson®、Blondo®、Carvela® 及 Anne Klein®。此分部也包含我們的自有品牌鞋類業務。此分部於2025年佔總營業收入的40.9%。

我們的通路配件/服飾應報告分部設計、來源並行銷我們的品牌，並銷售產品，主要為手提包及服飾，至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、線上零售商、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部。此外，本公司透過在南非、中東、以色列、澳洲、歐洲各國、拉丁美洲及亞洲部分國家的合資企業，以及在歐洲各國、北非、南美及中美洲以及亞太地區各國的特殊分銷安排，經營其他國際市場。我們的通路配件/服飾業務包含手提包、服飾、小皮製品、皮帶、軟質配件、時尚圍巾、披肩、禮品及其它時尚配件。通路配件/服飾應報告分部包含以下品牌：Steve Madden®、Kurt Geiger®、Dolce Vita®、Betsey Johnson®、Carvela®、ATM® 及 Anne Klein®。此分部也包含我們的自有品牌手提包及配件業務。此分部於2025年佔總營業收入的25.3%。

我們的直接對消費者應報告分部透過 Steve Madden、Kurt Geiger、Carvela、Dolce Vita 及 ATM 的全價零售商店、Steve Madden、Kurt Geiger 及 Carvela 的折扣商店、國際市場的直接經營租賃店面及直接經營電商平台，銷售鞋類、手提包、服飾及其他時尚配件。我們在美國、英國、加拿大、墨西哥、南非、中東、以色列、歐洲、拉丁美洲及亞太地區各國的區域購物中心及購物街設有零售據點。透過我們的租賃業務，我們也在英國的豪華及高檔百貨公司及國際市場的各個百貨公司內經營鞋類租賃店面。我們的商店在我們的測試與反應策略中扮演重要角色，同時也作為電商業務的發貨與退貨據點。我們的商店也作為行銷工具，使我們能強化全球品牌認知度，並展示我們全系列品牌及授權產品中的選項。
除了這些測試與行銷優勢外，我們也利用在 Steve Madden 零售商店及電商平台所收集的銷售資訊，協助我們的通路客戶進行訂單下達及存貨管理。我們認為，我們的零售商店及電商平台能提升整體銷售與獲利，並提高我們對消費者需求變化的反應速度。

截至2025年12月31日，我們經營399間實體零售商店，包括251間Steve Madden全價商店及69間折扣商店、31間Kurt Geiger倫敦全價商店及17間折扣商店、14間Carvela全價商店及12間折扣商店、4間Dolce Vita全價商店及1間ATM全價商店。此外，我們在臺灣有21間租賃店面、南非有20間、澳洲有16間、葡萄牙及中國各2間，以及在英國的豪華及高檔百貨公司內有72間鞋類租賃店面，總計在國際市場有133間租賃店面。

除我們的實體門市外，我們的直營消費者業務透過我們的電商平台，在美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大、墨西哥，以及我們在國際市場的合資公司，提供產品在網路上銷售。我們經營七個品牌電商網站，包括：www.stevemadden.com、www.kurtgeiger.com、www.dolcevita.com、www.betseyjohnson.com、www.blondo.com、www.carvela.com 和 www.atmcollection.com。此應報告分部在 2025 年佔總營業收入的 33.4%。
我們的授權業務從事 Steve Madden®、Kurt Geiger® 和 Betsey Johnson® 商標的授權，用於銷售特定的服飾、配件及居家商品，以及各種其他非核心商品。我們大多數的授權協議要求授權人根據實際銷售額支付本公司 royalty，若預定銷售目標未達成則支付最低 royalty，並根據銷售額支付品牌廣告費用。此應報告分部在 2025 年佔總營業收入的 0.5%。
企業管理部門不構成應報告分部，包含不直接歸屬於應報告營運分部的成本。這些費用主要與企業高管、企業財務、企業社會責任、法律、人力資源、資訊科技、網路安全及其他共享服務相關。
如需更多關於我們分部的資訊，請參閱本年度報告附錄中的第 18 註 – 營運分部資訊。

Steve Madden。我們在 Steve Madden 品牌下設計、採購並行銷時尚前衛的鞋類、配件及服飾。Steve Madden 品牌在時尚鞋類產業中為領導品牌，並獲得客戶許可，在大多數鞋類類別中銷售產品，包括正裝鞋、靴子、短靴、時尚運動鞋及休閒鞋。雖然該品牌吸引廣泛的消費者羣，但核心目標消費者為 18 至 40 歲。Steve Madden 品牌在全球銷售，包括美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大、墨西哥、非洲、亞太地區、中東及南美洲。

Kurt Geiger London。Kurt Geiger® 是一家位於倫敦的可負擔奢華配件與鞋類品牌，以其獨特的品牌形象、大膽且具特色的設計美學及強大的價值主張而聞名。Kurt Geiger 於 1963 年成立，總部設於英國倫敦。2025 年 5 月，我們透過收購 Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited（"MATL"），即 Kurt Geiger 的最終母公司，取得 Kurt Geiger® 商標。Kurt Geiger® 品牌在全球銷售，包括英國、美國、歐洲、墨西哥及亞太地區。

Steven Madden, Ltd. 及其子公司設計、來源並行銷時尚前衛的自有品牌與私標鞋類、配件及服飾。我們透過連鎖通路將產品銷售至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、鞋類連鎖店、線上零售商、全國連鎖店、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部。此外，我們透過在南非、中東、以色列、澳洲、歐洲多個國家、拉丁美洲及亞洲部分國家的合資企業，以及在歐洲多個國家、北非、南美及亞太地區的特殊分銷協議，經營其他國際市場。我們也透過直接對消費者通路銷售產品，包括本公司經營的零售商店、國際市場的第三方租賃店面及電商平台，於美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大、墨西哥、南非、中東、以色列、拉丁美洲及亞太地區進行銷售。
我們的產品組合包含多樣化的當代風格，旨在建立或把握市場趨勢，並搭配核心產品組合。我們以設計創意及能以具競爭力的價格提供高品質、快速上市的產品而聞名。
本公司應報告分部如下：
•鞋類通路。此分部設計、來源並行銷我們的品牌，銷售產品，包含鞋類，至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、鞋類連鎖店、線上零售商、全國連鎖店、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部，以及透過我們的合資企業及國際分銷網路。
•配件/服飾通路。此分部設計、來源並行銷我們的品牌，銷售產品，主要為手提包及服飾，至美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的百貨公司、折扣零售商、線上零售商、專業零售商、獨立商店及俱樂部，以及透過我們的合資企業及國際分銷網路。

•直接對消費者。此分部透過 Steve Madden、Kurt Geiger London、Dolce Vita 及 Carvela 的全價零售商店、Steve Madden、Kurt Geiger London 及 Carvela 的折扣商店、直接經營的電商平台、直接經營的國際市場租賃店面，以及在英國的高檔及精品百貨公司的第三方租賃店面，銷售鞋類、手提包、服飾及其他配件。我們在美國、英國、歐洲、加拿大及墨西哥的區域購物中心及購物街，以及透過我們的合資企業在國際市場經營零售據點。
•授權。此分部透過授權 Steve Madden®、Betsey Johnson® 及 Kurt Geiger® 商標，用於銷售特定的服飾、配件及居家商品，以及各種其他非核心產品。
本公司不構成應報告分部，且包含無法直接歸屬於應報告營運分部的成本。這些費用主要與公司高階主管、公司財務、公司社會責任、法律、人力資源、資訊科技、網路安全及其他共享服務相關。
澳洲合資企業。2025年1月，本公司取得新成立實體SM Fashion Australia Pty Ltd 50.1%的控制性財務權益。此合資企業成立係為了透過批發及直營通路，擴大本公司產品在澳洲及紐西蘭的銷售。此合資企業的營運成果已納入批發鞋類、批發配件/服飾及直營通路分部。

馬來西亞合資企業。2025年1月，本公司取得SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 額外2.0%的股權。SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 原於2022年7月成立，當時本公司持有該實體49.0%的非控制性權益。現本公司已持有該實體51.0%的控制性財務權益。SM Distribution Malaysia Sdn. Bhd. 透過直營通路銷售本公司產品於馬來西亞。此合資企業的營運成果已納入直營通路分部。
取得 Kurt Geiger。於 2025 年 5 月，本公司完成先前公告取得 Mercury Acquisitions Topco Limited（"MATL"）全部發行股本，初步購價為 403,348 美元。

MATL 為Kurt Geiger業務（"Kurt Geiger"）的最終母公司，該業務主要於英國（"UK"）、美國及歐洲運作。Kurt Geiger 自設品牌設計並銷售鞋類及配件，包括Kurt Geiger London、KG Kurt Geiger 及Carvela，透過直營通路（包含直接經營零售商店及電商）及批發通路銷售，並在英國等地的豪華及高檔百貨公司設有第三方特許經營店。Kurt Geiger 於1963年成立，總部設於英國倫敦。

headings: Steve Madden, 我們創辦人及創意與設計總裁，或我們高階管理團隊成員的離職，可能對我們的業務造成重大不利影響。
若我們未能成功執行成長策略或整合收購的企業，我們可能無法把握某些市場機會，並可能變得較不具競爭力。
若我們的重要客戶中之一或數家減少或停止購買我們的產品，我們的銷售與利潤可能下降。
我們的財務結果會受到季節性波動的影響。
我們或我們的客戶與供應商所處地區若發生極端或不尋常的天氣狀況，可能對我們的業務造成不利影響。
我們將大部分現金貨產品銷售給我們的經銷客戶，並依照慣例的貿易付款條件進行信用銷售，若這些客戶未能支付所購產品的貨款，可能對我們的財務結果造成不利影響。
若我們的營運結果與我們的預測或追蹤我們的分析師預測不一致，我們的股票價格可能大幅波動。
未能成功整合 Kurt Geiger 的業務與運作，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及未來成長前景造成不利影響。
我們已就取得 Kurt Geiger 一事記錄 goodwill 及可辨識的智慧財產權，這些資產可能發生減損，並對我們的財務結果產生不利影響。
我們的全球營運使我們面臨多種法律、法規、政治及經濟風險，這些風險可能對某些地區的營運結果產生不利影響。
我們的業務面臨外匯匯率波動的風險。
資訊科技系統或電子商務平台的中斷，可能對我們的財務結果及品牌價值產生重大且不利的影響。
我們的業務可能因系統或第三方合作夥伴系統的資料安全事件或隱私權失誤而受到不利影響。
與人工智慧及機器學習部署相關的風險，可能對我們的營運及財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們的部分營收依賴於授權我們的商標。我們的授權合作夥伴的行為可能損害我們的品牌完整性，並對我們的營收及營運結果產生不利影響。
經濟條件的變化可能對我們的財務狀況、營運結果及流動性產生不利影響。
訴訟或其他法律程序可能使管理階層分散資源，並導致成本影響我們每季營運成果。
我們可能因各稅務機關的審計而面臨額外稅務負擔。
稅法變更可能對我們財務結果產生不利影響。
若無法維持有效的內部控制以確保財務報告，可能對我們造成重大且不利的影響。
paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱我們在下文中所描述的風險與不確定性，以及本年度報告表10-K中包含的所有其他資訊，再做任何投資決策。本報告中所包含的風險與不確定性並非完整無遺。本報告的其他部分也會討論可能對我們業務產生負面影響的其他因素。我們所處的產業具有高度競爭性且持續演進，我們可能面臨目前未知、被認為不重要或未預見的風險。如果任何這些風險與不確定性實現，將可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與流動性產生重大且負面的影響。
時尚鞋類、配件與服飾產業會因消費者偏好快速變動。如果我們無法準確預測時尚趨勢並迅速回應消費者需求，我們可能失去銷售，與客戶的關係可能受損，並導致品牌忠誠度下降。

我們品牌的強度與成功，在很大程度上取決於我們預測並迅速回應產品與時尚趨勢，以及預測、衡量並及時回應消費者需求的能力。無法保證我們的產品會符合消費者品味與需求的變化，也無法保證我們能成功推廣與行銷符合趨勢與消費者偏好的產品。如果我們誤判產品市場，我們可能面臨某些產品的大量存貨，而其他產品則錯過機會。此外，商品選擇的誤判可能對我們與客戶的品牌形象造成負面影響，導致銷售減少與客戶的折扣允許增加，這可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與流動性產生重大且負面的影響。
我們面臨來自既有公司與新進市場參與者的強烈競爭。我們若無法有效競爭，可能導致市場佔有率下降，這可能損害我們的聲譽，並對我們的財務狀況、營運成果與流動性產生重大且負面的影響。

時尚鞋類、配件與服飾產業具有高度競爭性，產業進入門檻低。我們的競爭對手包括專業公司與產品線多元化的公司。時尚鞋類、配件與服飾銷售的市場成長已促使許多新進競爭者進入市場，並增加既有公司的競爭壓力。這些競爭者中，許多可能擁有遠高於我們的財務及其他資源，無法保證我們能成功與其他時尚鞋類、配件與服飾公司競爭。競爭增加可能導致價格壓力、行銷費用增加與市場佔有率流失，這可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果與流動性產生重大且負面的影響。
如果我們與零售商客戶無法適應零售產業近期與預期的變化，我們產品的銷售可能下降，這可能對我們的財務狀況、營運成果與流動性產生重大且負面的影響。
